name: Winter Nights Signature Bundle - Classic Stone, Royal Blend, Arabesque
english_product_name: Winter Nights Signature Bundle - Classic Stone, Royal Blend, Arabesque
description: The Winter Nights Signature Bundle is built for those who want a distinctive, refined presence during cold evenings and formal moments. This is not sweet, playful, or casual — it’s elegant, confident, and composed . This trio delivers three layers of winter sophistication: Classic Stone provides a smooth, mineral-woody backbone with niche character Royal Blend adds warm spice, richness, and regal depth Arabesque completes the set with refined amber, woods, and a polished Middle Eastern touch Together, these fragrances create a signature winter rotation — perfect for nights out, upscale settings, and moments when presence matters more than loud projection. Ideal for customers who want to smell mature, elegant, and expensive .
